subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"various"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Various** refers to something that is **two or more of a distinct kind**.
 
• Here the speaker is talking about the **different type** of **unethical acts**.
 
• According to the sentence, Over the past ten years, numerous supermarket chains have faced criticism for alleged unethical behaviour.

The correct sentence is **Many of the major supermarket chains have come under fire with accusations of various__ unethical acts over the past decade.**
